marie: quick sync — debating validation patterns for the Create Alert form. two questions: 1) inline live errors vs top-of-form summary for multi-field errors, 2) required marker: asterisk or explicit 'Required'? also need confirmation pattern for bulk 'Delete all' (checkbox vs typed confirm). any strong opinions? :eyes: daniel: for short forms i prefer inline live validation. users get instant feedback, fewer trips to top. for long/bulk edits show summary + anchor links to fields. abby: +1 on inline for single-field. about required marker — i'd vote for explicit `Required` label (visually) and reserve asterisk as a lightweight affordance. less guessing for non-technical users. alex (a11y): accessibility notes: always expose required with aria-required on the input, don't rely solely on visual asterisk. for inline errors use role="alert" or aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce changes. focus management: move focus to first invalid field when submitting. quick snippets: ```html
Email is required
``` shay: on destructive confirmation — typed confirm is safest for bulk deletes. checkbox is fine for single-item delete but for "Delete all" typed confirm reduces accidental mass deletion. copy suggestions: - short: "Type DELETE to confirm" - safer: "Type DELETE to permanently remove all alerts" - or require typing the workspace name for extra protection. daniel: typed confirm is higher friction though. can we do tiered rules? e.g., single alert -> small modal + checkbox, 5+ or all alerts -> typed confirm. also show item count in the modal. marie: good point. also want to keep keyboard-first flow — typed confirm needs to be keyboard-friendly and should validate inline (show error under the input). do we announce validation failures via live region? alex (a11y): yes — validate inline and announce with aria-live. set aria-invalid on the input when mismatch. keep focus inside the modal (focus trap) and ensure Escape closes it. sample live region approach: ```html
"Typed value doesn't match"
``` also: color alone shouldn't indicate error; include icon + text. abby: a microcopy nit — always call out irreversibility and timeline: "This action cannot be undone. Alerts will be removed immediately and cannot be recovered." short and clear reduces accidental clicks. design-bot: uploaded: Figma file — "alerts-form-validation_v3" (link) :paperclip: marie: summary / action items: 1) spec two validation presets: (A) inline live validation for short forms, (B) top-summary + anchored errors for long/bulk forms; 2) required marker: visual 'Required' + decorative asterisk; programmatically set aria-required; 3) destructive pattern: checkbox for single deletes, typed confirm for bulk/"Delete all" with count + explicit irreversible copy; 4) a11y checklist: aria-live for errors, focus to first invalid, focus trap in modal, escape closes. i'll update the figma and PR the copy. tagging: @daniel @abby @alex for quick thumbs up when you can. :thumbsup:
